records.reason: Routing has possible resource implications but no measured inference-efficiency benefit.

records.title: MambaLRP: Explaining Selective State Space Sequence Models
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.07592. Abstract summary: Recent sequence modeling approaches using selective state space sequence models, referred to as Mamba models, have seen a surge of interest. These models allow efficient processing of long sequences in linear time and are rapidly being adopted in a wide range of applications such as language modeling, demonstrating promising performance.  Out of scope: Mamba explainability algorithm; efficient Mamba is context, not the contribution.

records.title: RMBench: Memory-Dependent Robotic Manipulation Benchmark with Insights into Policy Design
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01229. Abstract summary: Robotic manipulation policies have made rapid progress in recent years, yet most existing approaches give limited consideration to memory capabilities. Consequently, they struggle to solve tasks that require reasoning over historical observations and maintaining task-relevant information over time, which are common requirements in real-wo Out of scope: Robotic manipulation memory benchmark, not LLM inference.

records.title: MegaScience: Pushing the Frontiers of Post-Training Datasets for Science Reasoning

Abstract summary: Scientific reasoning is critical for developing AI scientists and supporting human researchers in advancing the frontiers of natural science discovery. records.title: HARDSEA: Hybrid Analog-ReRAM Clustering and Digital-SRAM In-Memory Computing Accelerator for Dynamic Sparse Self-Attention in Transformer
records.reason: Transformer inference hardware evidence exists, but applicability is limited to specialized CIM hardware and older BERT/GPT-2 models.
